review.title: Review / Diff
review.confirmationBoundary: Agents and the Knowledge Steward can only prepare drafts or proposals. Applying knowledge requires this explicit user confirmation.

steward.boundaryNotice: The Steward can never apply changes directly. This boundary is enforced mechanically.

runtime.title: Runtime Lessons
runtime.subtitle: Review runtime evidence, decide which suggestions become durable principles, and retrieve confirmed principles for advisory use.
runtime.reviewBoundary: Suggestions and review do not write durable knowledge. Only explicit confirmation with session lineage can persist a principle; retrieval stays advisory and is never attached to a conversation automatically.
runtime.emptyIndex: No runtime lesson index is available.
runtime.adoptionDiagnostic: Adoption counts are diagnostic only. Automatic adoption is not recorded, and counts do not rank handoff context.
runtime.suggestionsDescription: Select the exact candidate to inspect. Selection and edits remain mutation-free until confirmation.
runtime.noSuggestions: Request suggestions from the undistilled runs to begin review.
runtime.retrieveDescription: Search active confirmed principles and inspect the bounded advisory text. This does not enable automatic prompt injection.
runtime.taskIntentPlaceholder: What are you trying to do?
runtime.noRetrieved: No confirmed principles matched this task.

errors.shadow: Could not generate shadow evaluation report.

runtime.captureDescription: Manual trajectories are audit-only and are not distillation candidates.
runtime.distillDescription: Run batch distillation suggestions over undistilled trajectories.

governance.title: Governance
governance.stewardDescription: A role-first slot that classifies, checks sources, finds conflicts, and proposes changes without applying them directly.
governance.permissionsDescription: Chat knowledge scope only grants search/get access. Writes, merges, archives, and deletes must pass through draft or proposal review and user confirmation.
governance.noReview: No steward review has run in this session.

qualityMetrics.title: Quality Metrics
qualityMetrics.description: Compact health signals for retrieval quality and repeated-error cards.

hints.stale_cards: Cards or pages with stale signals.
hints.source_gaps: Items missing usable provenance or source links.
hints.unreferenced_pages: Pages not connected to other reviewed knowledge.
hints.low_confidence_high_hit_cards: Experience cards that fire often despite low confidence.
hints.high_dismissal_cards: Experience cards users dismiss more than they accept.

governance.allClearHint: No governance issues detected. Run a health check to verify.

errors.ownerReadDenied: This source is unavailable or its permission, version, or read range has changed. Select a valid reference again.

lifecycle.title: Page lifecycle governance
lifecycle.description: Create governed update/merge/archive/revoke/delete/restore proposals for memory-wiki pages. Every apply re-checks expectedRevision and returns an EffectReceipt.
lifecycle.policyBoundary: Proposals require explicit user confirmation before the wiki RPC runs.
lifecycle.receiptEmpty: Apply a proposal to see its EffectReceipt here.

toasts.proposed: Lifecycle proposal created and awaiting confirmation.
